answer_rationale: Text 7 mentions that the best models use BiLSTM models combined with grapheme-level representations. Text 8 highlights that fasttext skip gram model word vectors perform better due to their ability to capture morphological structure, which is particularly important for Nepali. Text 10 also suggests future work involving BERT, ELMo, and FLAIR, but these are not confirmed as used in the current study.
